messages:
maria.ong: Handoff check-in — wrapping up the night rotation. Quick summary below.

maria.ong: What I did: monitored embed-service after yesterday's capacity bump, applied a temporary rate-limit patch to the ingest proxy, validated canary traffic for 30m. No new P1s overnight.

maria.ong: Current incidents: 1) embed-ingest rate spikes -> retries (P2). Mitigation: enabled token-bucket limit at proxy and blocked one noisy client id via firewall rule. 2) gpu-pool-4 showed sustained CPU high (non-oom), autoscaler kept latency within SLO.

akshay: Thanks. Are the noisy client ids and when they started recorded?

maria.ong: yes — added the list and first-seen times to the incident doc: https://internal/redwood/incidents/18375-embed-spike (see "noisy_clients" section).

sam_k: Did the rate-limiter cause any tail latency regression in the canary? I saw a small uptick in 95p.

maria.ong: Canary 95p went 180ms -> 210ms during the enforced limits. Tradeoff accepted to prevent retry storms. We left canary traffic at 5% for 45m and saw error-rate drop ~82%.

lina: Is fallback routing still enabled for that tenant? We want to avoid feature regressions.

maria.ong: yes, fallback to embed-model-v2-q4 is active for requests >1000 tokens. Config excerpt: 

```yaml
routing:
  - match: client_noisy_123
    action: limit
    token_bucket: 100
  - fallback_model: embed-model-v2-q4
```

deploy-bot: deploy finished: rate-limiter patch v1.3 deployed to embed-proxy in prod (177 nodes) — https://deploys/redwood/4567 :white_check_mark:

akshay: I'll follow up with Solutions to reach out to the noisy client. Also pinging @lina for a quick CR review on the rate-limiter config change.

lina: Assigning review now, will check at 13:15 PST.

maria.ong: Monitoring checklist for next shift:
- watch ops/embed/ingest dashboard (error-rate, retries/min, token-bucket drops)
- verify noisy-client blacklist isn't growing unexpectedly
- if gpu-pool-4 CPU >85% for 10m -> bump scale policy +2 nodes and notify infra oncall
- escalate: page infra oncall if retries >1000/min for >5m

maria.ong: Runbook & docs: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/embed-ingest.md ; incident doc: link above. Dashboards pinned in #eng-oncall.

sam_k: Got it. I'm taking the shift from 13:00 PST and will watch the dashboards.

akshay: Thanks Maria — appreciate the thorough notes :thumbsup:

maria.ong: Leaving recent logs for quick context:

``
[2026-03-16T12:12:04Z] embed-proxy: token_bucket_throttle: client_noisy_123 -> dropped=432
[2026-03-16T12:37:10Z] embed-proxy: fallback_route applied -> model=embed-model-v2-q4
``

maria.ong: Handoff complete.
